spec: Phase A1A Gate 1 Step 1 — post-migration git object scan interpretation

hit_blob_classification.commit_message: audit/phase-a0.1r: audit package (Bucket B) — Phase A0.1R Gate 9
hit_blob_classification.charter_rule_forbidden: A1A charter §3.1 — MUST NOT amend Commit A/B/C of the Phase A0.1R freeze

current_working_tree_state_after_gate1_s.interpretation: The new working-tree blob (fe2bbe8d) has been migrated. The OLD immutable Commit B blob (4573c81) persists in the object database because git objects are content-addressable and immutable.

interim_scan_verdict_reconciliation.rationale: The scanner scans ALL blobs in the object database (loose + packed), not just current HEAD blobs. Once a blob is committed, it persists until garbage collection. The OLD Commit B blob will remain indefinitely because it is reachable from the audit/phase-a0.1r-baseline tag (an immutable Phase A0.1R baseline).
interim_scan_verdict_reconciliation.charter_scenario_match: A1A charter §6.2 explicitly anticipates this scenario. The charter allows partial-block state if (a) the residual blob is from an immutable historical commit, (b) chars 17-48 are NOT in any git object (confirmed), (c) the credential is DB-invalidated (confirmed), and (d) the residual leak is disclosed. All four conditions met.
interim_scan_verdict_reconciliation.a1a_g0_d01_status_post_gate1_step1: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED — chars 9-16 no longer in CURRENT validator; chars 9-16 persist ONLY in immutable Commit B blob (cannot be amended per charter)

alternative_full_resolution_path.name: Option A — SHA-256 hash anchor (deferred per sub-gate 0E)
alternative_full_resolution_path.what_it_would_do: Replace SECRET_FINGERPRINT_SUBSTRING with sha256(full_secret). The CURRENT validator would contain no secret material at all.
alternative_full_resolution_path.what_it_would_NOT_do: Cannot remove chars 9-16 from the historical Commit B blob. That blob remains in the object database forever.
alternative_full_resolution_path.implication: Even with Option A, the scanner would still report 1 hit on blob 4573c81. The PARTIAL_BLOCK state is structural, not fixable by Gate 1 alone.
alternative_full_resolution_path.decision: Option B selected for Gate 1 — closes CURRENT leak surface. Option A deferred to a future phase if/when a full repo re-initialization is acceptable (would require creating a new master without the Phase A0.1R Commit B).

negative_fixtures_re_run_post_migration.note: NF12 (worktree.no_secret injection test) still works because it patches SECRET_FINGERPRINT_SUBSTRING in-memory to a benign marker, regardless of the original constant value.

verdict: GATE_1_STEP_1_COMPLETE — CURRENT leak surface closed (chars 9-16 no longer in working-tree validator). Historical Commit B blob persists per immutable baseline guarantee. Option A (full SHA-256 anchor) would not change the scanner verdict because the historical blob cannot be amended. A1A-G0-D01 status: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED (current) + STRUCTURALLY_IMMUTABLE (historical).
